The subscription budget warns the action group at $50, $100 and $200 of actual spend, and the action group emails the owner. A budget never stops spending.

The activity log is copied into a Log Analytics workspace. The budget and that copy sit on the subscription, outside the resource group, so the nightly delete skips them; only terraform destroy removes them.

Dotted pieces are not written yet. The Logic App is an empty container and its email step is a portal click. The pipeline cannot create the budget or the diagnostic setting, so those are applied from the laptop.
